BC_description: Promise.promisify, Promise.promisifyAll, and Promise.fromCallback now ignore multiple callback arguments by default, resolving only with the first argument, unlike 2.x which used an array for multiple arguments.
Adaptation_method: Use the multiArgs option set to true to preserve the old behavior of resolving with an array of arguments. Example: Before - No option needed; After - Promise.promisify(fn, {multiArgs: true});
RequireInfo: Clarification needed on whether the multiArgs option is available for all three methods (promisify, promisifyAll, fromCallback) and if there are any differences in its usage or default behavior across them.
